mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_release_history (version, type, description, updated_by, released_at) VALUES (#{version}, #{type}, #{description}, #{updatedBy}, #{releasedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT release_id, version, type, description, updated_by, released_at FROM system_release_history WHERE type = #{type} ORDER BY released_at DESC, release_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT release_id, version, type, description, updated_by, released_at FROM system_release_history ORDER BY released_at DESC, release_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
